title: Move Slides to Backup (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Move Slides to Backup applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Move Slides to Backup (BtnMoveToBackup) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Designated Backup slide recognition and confirmation wording are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: A slide is the designated Backup slide when either the oPE_BackupSlide or the EE4P_BACKUP_SLIDE tag carries 'True' (case-insensitive; missing, empty or other values do not qualify), and the move/copy confirmation reads '{Move|Copy} {count} selected slide(s) to the end, behind Backup slide {index}?'

scenarios.title: Move Slides to Backup Locate action navigates to the tagged backup slide in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Move Slides to Backup Locate action on a two-slide fixture whose second slide carries the oPE_BackupSlide tag navigates the real view to the backup slide (measured navigatedTo=2 expectedIndex=2), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
